thread:
ana (support): Hey team, escalated customer 'VegaHealth' reports huge tail latency and intermittent 5xxs. They claim they set region pin to eu-west but traffic shows served from us-east. Customer sees long queue times then automatic cross-region fallback. Customer impact: timeouts in production.

sam (eng-runtime): Can you paste the original request headers and one request-id? Also any sample client timestamps.

ana (support): curl they ran: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Region-Pref: eu-west" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat` Response headers include `x-served-region: us-east-1` and `x-request-id: rq_veg_01` . They also saw `503` on retries after long queueing.

olivia (sre): Checking infra graphs now — eu-west had a short capacity exhaustion at 2026-02-12T11:02:14Z, autoscaler lagged ~30s while queued backlog spiked. There is a router metric `spillover_count` bump at that time.

mike (eng-platform): This smells like routing fallback + sticky routing mismatch. If a request hits the overflow path, the router may not persist the original pin metadata when requeuing to fallback region. That would cause subsequent requests in the same session to go to the fallback region even if pin was requested. I'll try to repro.

sam (eng-runtime): Repro plan: run a short load on eu-west until queueing starts, capture router span and `routing_meta` on the handoff. Need to confirm if `X-Region-Pref` is dropped or overwritten. Can someone grant me a test customer id?

ana (support): Gave sam customer test id veg-test-2026 and shared the exact request-ids with logs via DM. Customer confirmed a manual retry after we disabled cross-region fallback returned to eu-west and latency normalized.

mike (eng-platform): Quick mitigation applied: temporarily set routing policy to honor `X-Region-Pref` for pinned customers and disabled automatic cross-region spillover for that customer id. Please monitor.

olivia (sre): Metrics: after mitigation, queue length and p50 latency returned to normal for VegaHealth. We'll need a proper fix: ensure router preserves pin metadata across queue handoffs and fixes the spillover decision path.

sam (eng-runtime): Filed reproducer and initial diffs. Candidate root cause: when queueing triggers a serialized handoff we drop `pin_region` key in the metadata map. Patch will thread pin through queue object.

deploy-bot: mike started a canary deploy for the temporary policy change -> 5% -> 100% :rocket:

mike (eng-platform): Ticket PLATFORM-4821 created for the long-term fix and QA. Action items: (1) sam to push router patch and test, (2) olivia to validate autoscaler thresholds to avoid short OOM cascades, (3) support to update customer with ETA. Ana please confirm updates to the customer.

ana (support): Will share status with VegaHealth and mark as escalated. Thanks all, will re-open if anything else surfaces.
